joyful-1-annunciation: The Annunciation: the archangel Gabriel, winged, kneels before the young Virgin Mary in a quiet room in Nazareth; Mary, veiled, hands crossed on her breast in humble assent; a white lily; a dove of the Holy Spirit in a soft ray of light from above.
joyful-2-visitation: The Visitation: the young Virgin Mary, veiled, embraces her older cousin Elizabeth at the doorway of a hill-country house in Judea; both women joyful; a path and hills behind.
joyful-3-nativity: The Nativity: the newborn Christ Child lies in a manger of straw in a humble stable in Bethlehem; the Virgin Mary kneels beside him in adoration, Saint Joseph stands with a staff; an ox and a donkey; a bright star above.
joyful-4-presentation: The Presentation in the Temple: the Virgin Mary and Saint Joseph present the infant Jesus in the Temple of Jerusalem; the old man Simeon holds the Child in his arms; Joseph carries two turtledoves; the prophetess Anna nearby.
joyful-5-finding-in-the-temple: The Finding in the Temple: the twelve-year-old Jesus sits among the teachers of the law in the Temple, who listen amazed with scrolls in hand; Mary and Joseph arrive at the doorway, relieved.
luminous-1-baptism: The Baptism of the Lord: John the Baptist, in camel hair, pours water over Jesus standing in the river Jordan; the heavens open and the dove of the Holy Spirit descends in light.
luminous-2-wedding-at-cana: The Wedding at Cana: at a wedding feast, the Virgin Mary speaks to Jesus and points to large stone water jars; servants pour water that has become wine; guests at a table behind.
luminous-3-proclamation-of-the-kingdom: The Proclamation of the Kingdom: Jesus seated on a hillside by the Sea of Galilee teaches a gathered crowd of men, women and children; one hand raised in blessing.
luminous-4-transfiguration: The Transfiguration: on a mountaintop Jesus stands in dazzling white garments radiating light, with Moses and Elijah at his sides; the apostles Peter, James and John fall to the ground below, shielding their eyes.
luminous-5-institution-of-the-eucharist: The Institution of the Eucharist: at the Last Supper Jesus, seated at the center of the table with the twelve apostles, raises the bread in blessing; a chalice of wine before him.
sorrowful-1-agony-in-the-garden: The Agony in the Garden: at night in the garden of Gethsemane Jesus kneels in prayer at a rock, an angel with a chalice appearing above him; three apostles asleep nearby under olive trees.
sorrowful-2-scourging-at-the-pillar: The Scourging at the Pillar: Jesus, bound to a stone pillar, head bowed, bears his suffering with patience; shown with restraint and dignity, no gore.
sorrowful-3-crowning-with-thorns: The Crowning with Thorns: Jesus seated, wearing a crown of thorns and a purple cloak, holding a reed as a mock scepter, his face calm and sorrowful; shown with restraint, no gore.
sorrowful-4-carrying-of-the-cross: The Carrying of the Cross: Jesus carries the wooden cross on his shoulder along the road to Calvary; Simon of Cyrene helps him lift it; the Virgin Mary and the women of Jerusalem follow in sorrow.
sorrowful-5-crucifixion: The Crucifixion: Jesus on the cross on Calvary beneath a darkened sky, the sign INRI above; the Virgin Mary and Saint John the Apostle stand at the foot of the cross, Mary Magdalene kneels; reverent, no gore.
glorious-1-resurrection: The Resurrection: the risen Christ, radiant in white with the wounds in his hands, steps out of the open tomb at dawn holding a white banner with a red cross; the stone rolled away.
glorious-2-ascension: The Ascension: Jesus rises into the sky over the Mount of Olives, hands raised in blessing, a cloud beneath his feet; the Virgin Mary and the apostles look up from below.
glorious-3-descent-of-the-holy-spirit: Pentecost: the Virgin Mary sits at the center of the apostles in the upper room; the dove of the Holy Spirit above them and a small tongue of fire over each head.
glorious-4-assumption: The Assumption: the Virgin Mary, body and soul, is taken up into heaven, rising on clouds surrounded by angels, arms open, gaze lifted; an empty tomb with flowers below.
glorious-5-coronation: The Coronation of the Virgin: in heaven Christ places a crown upon the head of the Virgin Mary, who kneels in humility; angels surround them in light.
